description: Use when someone wants to buy a puppy from a reputable breeder, e.g. 'find a Labrador breeder in Bavaria' or 'seriöser Züchter Golden Retriever Bayern'. Searches HonestDog's directory of vetted, APPROVED dog breeders — mostly in Germany and Austria, with some in other European countries (each result names its country). Filter by breed (slug from search_breeds; exact breed only — breeders of crosses such as Labradoodle are not listed under a parent breed), region (state in the breeder's country, German spelling, e.g. 'Bayern', 'Steiermark') or city. Returns kennel name, photo, city/region/country, HonestDog score and the honestdog.de profile URL — contact happens there, never through this tool. For Qualzucht breeds this returns a caution instead of results. / Für 'Welpen vom seriösen Züchter kaufen': durchsucht das Verzeichnis geprüfter Züchter (nur freigegebene Profile, öffentliche Daten; Ort nur als Stadt/Region/Land).

breed_slug.description: Restrict to breeders of this breed (slug from search_breeds)

state.description: Region in the breeder's country, German spelling — a German or Austrian Bundesland such as 'Bayern' or 'Steiermark' (English names like 'Bavaria' are mapped)

name: search_breeders
title: Search approved breeders
